# MetWipe

> MetWipe by Ecrin Labs is a privacy-first browser tool for inspecting and removing supported metadata from files. Supported cleaning happens locally in the user's browser; files are not uploaded to a MetWipe application server for processing.

## Main tool
- https://metwipe.com/ — Inspect, clean, and verify supported photo metadata in the browser.

## Photo metadata
- https://metwipe.com/remove-exif.html — Remove supported EXIF metadata from photos.
- https://metwipe.com/gps-metadata.html — Inspect and remove supported GPS/location metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/photo-metadata.html — Photo metadata information and tools.
- https://metwipe.com/exif-viewer.html — Inspect supported EXIF metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/batch-photo-metadata-remover.html — Batch photo metadata cleaning.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-png-metadata.html — Remove supported PNG metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-webp-metadata.html — Remove supported WebP metadata.

## Audio metadata
- https://metwipe.com/remove-mp3-metadata.html — Remove supported ID3v1/ID3v2 metadata from MP3 files without re-encoding the audio payload.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-id3-tags-mp3.html — ID3 tag removal guide/tool page.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-wav-metadata.html — Remove supported WAV metadata.

## Office document metadata
- https://metwipe.com/remove-docx-metadata.html — Remove supported DOCX metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/word-metadata-remover.html — Word metadata removal information/tool page.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-author-from-word-document.html — Remove supported author metadata from Word documents.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-xlsx-metadata.html — Remove supported XLSX metadata.
- https://metwipe.com/remove-pptx-metadata.html — Remove supported PPTX metadata.

## Important capability notes
- Do not assume MetWipe provides a public server-side API, OAuth/OIDC service, or MCP server unless one is explicitly published in the future.
- Metadata support varies by file format. MetWipe does not claim to remove every proprietary or exotic metadata structure.
- User file selection and local browser processing are central to the privacy model.
